decisions.reason: The conditional order for five additional videos does not change who supplies scripts, visual material, or voiceover for production.
The pilot quantity and conditional follow-on order do not alter the required lip-sync accuracy or natural facial-expression behavior.
The source only establishes a conditional follow-on order and does not resolve or modify the existing conflict over live-action versus AI-generated scenes.
The conditional expansion from the pilot does not change the specified target audience age range.
Although follow-on ordering depends on the pilot test working, the source does not redefine the campaign performance objective or the target cost per lead.
